final_claim: For Bernoulli X on {0,1} in the cyclic group Z_5, all independent convolution symmetrizers have minimum entropy min{h(t), -2r(t)log r(t)-s(t)log s(t)}, t=min(p,1-p), r=(1-2t)/(3-5t), s=(1-t)/(3-5t). A unique crossover t*=0.460751381649... separates the reflected Bernoulli and sparse three-point optimizers; exactly both minimize at equality and the balanced case admits one deterministic minimizer.
